#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

bool isSpecial(char ch) {
    return ch == '(' || ch == ')' || ch == '_';
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    bool inside = false;
    int insideLen = 0;
    int outsideLen = 0;
    int ans1 = 0, ans2 = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        if (inside) {
            if (ch == '_') {
                if (insideLen > 0) ans2++;
                insideLen = 0;
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                if (insideLen > 0) ans2++;
                insideLen = 0;
                inside = false;
            } else {
                insideLen++;
            }
        } else {
            if (ch == '(') {
                ans1 = max(ans1, outsideLen);
                outsideLen = 0;
                inside = true;
                insideLen = 0;
            } else if (isSpecial(ch)) {
                ans1 = max(ans1, outsideLen);
                outsideLen = 0;
            } else {
                outsideLen++;
            }
        }
    }
    ans1 = max(ans1, outsideLen);
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;
    return 0;
}
